evidence.detail: Issue itself states 'It's also low priority and a lot of work' and lists two required steps: new DB tables from Scryfall private tags API, and new find terms
find module implements search terms; adding otag:/atag: would require new tables and new term handlers, similar scope to existing format: or keyword: implementations
No existing otag or atag support found anywhere in the codebase

triage.notes: Scryfall's private/tags endpoints (api.scryfall.com/private/tags/oracle and /tags/illustration) are required. These are private/undocumented endpoints; their availability and stability should be confirmed before investing in implementation.
